title: Irish Potato Casserole
description: A comforting and creamy Irish-inspired potato casserole that's perfect for a cozy dinner.
instructions: In a large saucepan, combine sliced Irish potatoes and enough cold water to cover them. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to medium-low and simmer for 5 minutes or until slightly tender.
In a separate saucepan, melt butter over medium heat. Add flour and whisk to make a roux, cooking for 1-2 minutes.
Slowly pour in milk, whisking constantly to avoid lumps. Bring mixture to a simmer and cook until it thickens, about 2-3 minutes.
Stir in shredded creamy cheese until melted and smooth. Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
In a greased 9x13-inch baking dish, arrange a layer of cooked Irish potatoes.
Pour half of the creamy cheese sauce over the potatoes.
Repeat the layers, starting with the potatoes, then the remaining cheese sauce.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the casserole is heated through.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
